verdict.rationale: Parahelp's docs say configuration actions require manual approval by default. Approved actions publish as releases that are "reviewed, versioned, and revertable," and the Releases page offers impact tracking and one-click revert. Knowledge also has version history with per-change diffs. Since automations are Internal Agent tasks whose configuration actions go through this release flow, the core review/version/rollback loop is documented. missing for 10: explicit evidence that automation definitions themselves (schedule/trigger settings) are versioned and revertable, diff views for release or automation changes beyond knowledge, independent or hands-on corroboration.
